newsitem.title: USA: HCIA Inc sees Q2 EPS loss of $0.15-$0.18.
newsitem.headline: HCIA Inc sees Q2 EPS loss of $0.15-$0.18.

text.p: HCIA Inc said Monday it expects a second-quarter loss of between $0.15 and $0.18 a share and said the earnings shortfall was due to a revenue shortfall at its provider solutions unit.

It said its earnings at the unit will most likely fall short of expectations in the third and fourth quarters of 1997 also, it said. The unit was formed after the August 1996 acquisition of LBA Health Care Management Inc.

The shortfall is also due to the failure of its commercial markets and managed care units to finalize several significant agreements during the second quarter. It should finalize several of these pacts in the third and fourth quarters, and as a result, earnings per share for the third and fourth quarters will improve from the second quarter.
The company expects a smaller loss in the third quarter compared to the second quarter, and targets break-even earnings or a small profit for the fourth quarter.
